name: Cabezarrubias del Puerto (Spain)
description: Red field with a white lozenge throughout, charged at the centre with the crowned municipal arms of Cabezarrubias del Puerto (trees on red above a sheep on white).
history: Municipal flag of Cabezarrubias del Puerto; Spanish municipal flags are approved by the municipal council and the autonomous community and published in the regional official gazette.

features.role: Cabezarrubias del Puerto arms — trees above a sheep
